description: This source file defines a class 'HeaderFileParser' responsible for parsing C++ header files related to a specific software project. The parser extracts methods, properties, events, structs, enums, iterators, and annotations from header files, and generates request and response JSON examples for methods and events. It also populates and maintains symbol metadata such as descriptions, examples, and types, while handling doxygen tags, regex-based parsing, and structuring of C++ code components.

classes.name: HeaderFileParser
classes.description: A class that parses C++ header files to extract structural and organizational information about methods, structs, enums, iterators, and annotations. It creates internal representations of these components and generates sample request/response JSONs based on the parsed data.

methods.description: Initializes the parser with header file path, plugin name, and logger; then processes the file.

methods.name: process_header_file(self)
methods.description: Triggers parsing of header file and sorts registered methods, properties, and events.

methods.name: post_process(self)
methods.description: Performs post-parsing tasks such as generating examples and filling missing descriptions.

methods.name: parse_header_file(self)
